prompt: Coached in the 2023/24 season by Dusty May, this college basketball player was the 2023/24 co-winner of the AAC Player of the Year Award. Who is that player?
answer: The player was **Johnell Davis** of Florida Atlantic University. He shared the **2023–24 AAC Player of the Year** award with Memphis’s David Jones while coached by Dusty May.
